entries.title: Psalms 113:1
segments: ¶Hallelujah! Praise, ye servants of Jehovah, praise the name of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 113:2
segments: Blessed be the name of Jehovah, from this time forth and for evermore!

entries.title: Psalms 113:3
segments: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, let Jehovah's name be praised.

entries.title: Psalms 113:4
segments: Jehovah is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 113:5
segments: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, who hath placed his dwelling on high;

entries.title: Psalms 113:6
segments: Who humbleth himself to look on the heavens and on the earth?

entries.title: Psalms 113:7
segments: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust; from the dung-hill he lifteth up the needy,

entries.title: Psalms 113:8
segments: To set [him] among nobles, among the nobles of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 113:9
segments: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [as] a joyful mother of sons. Hallelujah!
